mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate indicates monetary easing, which can lead to increased borrowing and investment, thereby driving up S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases but S&P 500 returns are negative over 20 days in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment rates suggest a strong labor market, which can lead to increased consumer spending and higher corporate earnings, driving up S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If UNRATE is low but S&P 500 returns are negative over 20 days in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High GDP indicates strong economic activity, leading to higher corporate revenues and thus higher S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 is high but S&P 500 returns are negative over 60 days in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production suggests increased economic output, which can lead to higher S&P 500 returns as companies produce more goods.
failure_condition: If INDPRO exceeds 105 but S&P 500 returns are negative over 20 days in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When both unemployment rate and payroll employment increase, it indicates a strong labor market, leading to increased economic activity and higher S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If both UNRATE and PAYEMS increase but S&P 500 returns are negative over 20 days in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate coupled with low unemployment indicates a supportive monetary policy for economic growth, leading to higher S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS is low and UNRATE is low but S&P 500 returns are negative over 60 days in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts indicates strong demand in the housing market, leading to increased economic activity and higher S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If HOUST exceeds 1150 but S&P 500 returns are negative over 20 days in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High retail and food services sales indicate strong consumer demand, leading to higher corporate revenues and S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If RSAFS is high but S&P 500 returns are negative over 20 days in more than 40% of cases.
